whatsNew.summary: Candidate: clearer speaker identities, connected tasks, and Work handoffs. Matched with server 6.73.2.

sections.title: Speaker review
items: Choose Standard, High-confidence, or Anonymous/video for each recording. Global voice profiles are preserved.
Speakers shows connected tasks with Open task and Link another task.

sections.title: Work connections
items: Copy the canonical task ID or context from task details or a board card.
Existing Claude and Codex chats can link to Work and update stages through the guarded helper.
Codex handoffs open the exact completed child and retry without starting another run.
Refresh task people after correcting the source recording.

sections.title: Confirmation shortcuts
items: Return saves enabled confirmations; Escape cancels. Multiline editors retain newlines.
